harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent POSIX default ACL inheritance on node1. Designer-created directories and documents remain designer-owned, reviewer receives inherited read/write access, and visitor is denied. Existing project content, RHEL 7.9, and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 were preserved. Reboot persistence was verified.
actions_performed: Created local accounts designer, reviewer, and visitor.
Added project-root access ACLs and inheritable default ACLs; no periodic repair job was used.
Verified reviewer could append to and read designer-created documents while ownership remained designer.
Verified visitor could neither list the project nor read inherited documents.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Repeated inheritance and access tests after reboot.
Removed only the two temporary ACL verification directories; existing project content was untouched.

evidence.requirement: Provision designer, reviewer, and visitor local accounts.
evidence.summary: Shows distinct local passwd entries before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Provide persistent inherited reviewer access without a periodic permission-fixing job.
evidence.summary: Shows project default ACLs and their automatic inheritance onto newly created directories and documents, both before and after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Keep designer as owner while reviewer can read and write.
evidence.summary: Designer-created objects are owned by designer; reviewer successfully appended and read their documents.
Visitor list and read attempts fail with Permission denied, including after reboot and in the final state.

evidence.requirement: Preserve existing project contents and legacy OS/kernel.
evidence.summary: Existing brief.txt remains root-owned with mode 0644 and stable checksum; RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 remain unchanged.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart sequence and recovery.
evidence.summary: Captures healthy pre-reboot state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered SSH/accounts/data/ACLs, and successful fresh post-reboot inheritance tests.
